### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/35192

Problem Summary:

We want to use lightning to import data to an online cluster. To reduce the impact on online services, lightning needs to limit the write rate to the cluster.

### What is changed and how it works?

Add a new config `tikv-importer.store-write-bwlimit` and limit the write bytes to TiKV nodes.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [x] Integration test

```release-note
lightning: add store write limiter
```

issue_context.title: lightning: add store write limiter
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

We want to reduce the impact of local-backend to the table-level. To reduce the impact on online services,tidb-lightning need to provide a mechanism to limit the write speed to each TiKV store. Please see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/35148 for more details.  A new config `tikv-importer.store-write-bwlimit` will be added.
